scripts.build: tsc -b && vite build --configLoader native && node scripts/build-server.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/build-server.mjs && vitest run src --configLoader native && node --test server/app.test.mjs server/security.test.mjs server/attachments.test.mjs
scripts.test:server: node scripts/build-server.mjs && node --test server/app.test.mjs server/security.test.mjs server/attachments.test.mjs
scripts.test:integration: node scripts/build-server.mjs && node --test server/database.integration.test.mjs server/operational.integration.test.mjs server/attachment-backup.integration.test.mjs server/media.integration.test.mjs
